finePrint.summary: A lifetime plan lasts only as long as Spokk continues offering the Services, not for the buyer's lifetime.

quote.text: A lifetime plan gives you access to the plan you bought for as long as we offer the Services.

finePrint.summary: The regular subscription promises unlimited review and feedback requests, which is reassuring for high-volume use.

quote.text: Unlimited review and feedback requests by text and email.

finePrint.summary: Multiple locations and team members are included without extra per-site fees.

quote.text: Unlimited locations and team members, so a second site does not double your bill.

finePrint.summary: Agency use is limited by a shared yearly pool of credits across all client accounts.

quote.text: share one yearly pool of credits across all of them.

finePrint.summary: New buyers can get a full subscription refund if they ask within 60 days of first payment.

quote.text: if you are new to Spokk and ask within 60 days of your first paid subscription payment, we will refund what you have paid for your subscription in full.

finePrint.summary: Buyers have 60 days after first payment to request a full refund if the product is not right.

quote.text: If it is not right for your business, tell us within 60 days of your first payment and we refund what you paid, in full.

finePrint.summary: The 60-day money-back guarantee covers every plan including annual and Healthcare plans.

quote.text: Every new customer gets a 60-day money-back guarantee: if Spokk is not right for you, ask within 60 days of your first paid subscription payment and we refund what you paid for your subscription in full.

finePrint.summary: Spokk can change, add or remove features but promises reasonable notice before removing a relied-upon feature.

quote.text: We may change, add or remove features, and we will give you reasonable notice before removing a feature you rely on.

finePrint.summary: Price changes require at least 30 days notice before applying to the buyer's plan.

quote.text: We will give you at least 30 days’ notice of a price change before it applies to your plan.

finePrint.summary: Material Terms changes are announced at least 30 days in advance by email or dashboard notice.

quote.text: We will change the date at the top of this page and, for material changes, tell account holders by email or in the dashboard at least 30 days before the change takes effect.

finePrint.summary: Spokk may suspend or end access for serious or repeated violations, non-payment, legal risk or safety risk.

quote.text: We may suspend or end your access if you seriously or repeatedly break these Terms, do not pay, create legal risk for us or others, or put the Services or other users at risk.

finePrint.summary: If payment fails, paid features may be suspended after notice to the buyer.

quote.text: If a payment fails, we may suspend paid features after telling you.

finePrint.summary: Every plan includes email support with help from the support team.

quote.text: We offer email support on every plan. For faster help or specific needs, reach out to our support team and we'll be happy to help.

finePrint.summary: Custom features and integrations are built at no extra cost as part of the subscription.

quote.text: Custom features and integrations built for you at no extra cost

finePrint.summary: A real person keeps adjusting the setup until it fits the buyer's business.

quote.text: A real person who keeps adjusting it until it fits

finePrint.summary: The comparable regular price is $179 per month when paying monthly with no contract.

quote.text: Billed yearly, or $179 a month if you pay monthly with no contract.

finePrint.summary: The standard starting price is $149 per month billed yearly, or $1,788 per year.

quote.text: Spokk starts at $149 per month, billed yearly ($1,788 a year).

finePrint.summary: The Healthcare plan for HIPAA practices starts higher at $249 per month billed annually.

quote.text: It is billed annually and starts at $249 per month, and we set it up with you on a call.

exhibits.argument: The vendor states locations are unlimited and extra sites do not increase cost.

exhibits.quote: Import and reply to Google reviews with AI
exhibits.argument: The vendor lists import and reply to Google reviews as an included feature.

trials.claim: Plan 1 includes 1 location for import and reply to Google reviews

trials.claimQuote: 3 locations Import & reply to Google reviews
trials.reasoning: No exhibits were admitted for this claim, so there is no evidence confirming or contradicting the 3-location limit for Plan 2.

trials.claim: All future Tier 1, Tier 2, or Tier 3 updates are included
trials.claimQuote: All future Tier 1 (Plan 1), Tier 2 (Plan 2), or Tier 3 (Plan 3) updates
trials.reasoning: The binding terms say the vendor may remove features and that lifetime access lasts only as long as it offers the Services, materially limiting the promise that all future tier updates are included.

exhibits.quote: We may change, add or remove features, and we will give you reasonable notice before removing a feature you rely on.
exhibits.argument: The vendor reserves the right to remove features, so future updates are not guaranteed to be kept.

exhibits.quote: A lifetime plan gives you access to the plan you bought for as long as we offer the Services.
exhibits.argument: Access lasts only while the vendor offers the Services, so future updates stop if the service is discontinued.

exhibits.quote: Updates and new features are included too, as you would expect.
exhibits.argument: The vendor states updates and new features are included.

exhibits.quote: A lifetime plan gives you access to the plan you bought for as long as we offer the Services.
exhibits.argument: The terms confirm a lifetime plan provides ongoing access to the purchased plan.

trials.claim: Get customer feedback and 5-star Google reviews in under 15 seconds
trials.claimQuote: Get Customer Feedback and 5-star Google Reviews in under 15 seconds
trials.reasoning: The terms disclaim any guarantee of reviews or ratings, and the vendor says its figures are click-throughs to Google, not counted reviews, contradicting the promise of 5-star Google reviews.

exhibits.quote: We do not guarantee any number of reviews, any rating or ranking, or that every message will be delivered.
exhibits.argument: The vendor disclaims any guarantee of number of reviews or rating, contradicting the promise of 5-star reviews.

exhibits.quote: These are click-throughs to Google, not counted reviews.
exhibits.argument: The vendor admits its statistics measure click-throughs, not actual posted reviews.
